title: Agent Definitions Module
summary: This module defines various agent types and factories for constructing AI agents, ranging from classic ReAct and conversational agents to modern state-graph-based agents with advanced tool-calling and structured output capabilities. It provides core abstractions, specific implementations, and utilities for agent orchestration.

nodes.label: Convert Agent Action to Messages
nodes.title: Converts AgentAction to BaseMessage sequence
nodes.description: Transforms an AgentAction object into a list of BaseMessage objects, reconstructing the AI's original message for further processing.

nodes.label: Create Function Message
nodes.title: Generates FunctionMessage from AgentAction & observation
nodes.description: Converts an AgentAction and its observed result into a FunctionMessage, handling JSON serialization for non-string observations.

nodes.label: Base Agent
nodes.title: Abstract base class for LLM-driven agents
nodes.description: Provides the foundational structure for agents that use an LLMChain to decide actions, managing thought processes, intermediate steps, and tool interactions.

nodes.label: LLM Single Action Agent
nodes.title: Base for agents performing a single LLM-driven action
nodes.description: Defines the core logic for agents that execute one action at a time, driven by an LLMChain, including planning and execution.

nodes.label: Agent Type Enum
nodes.title: Enumeration of supported agent types
nodes.description: Defines various agent strategies like ReAct, Self-Ask, and OpenAI Functions, used for configuration and classification.

nodes.label: Chat Agent
nodes.title: Agent optimized for chat models
nodes.description: Extends the base Agent for conversational interactions, using a specific output parser and scratchpad construction tailored for chat environments.

nodes.label: Conversational Agent
nodes.title: Agent for conversational tasks with tools
nodes.description: Combines conversational capabilities with tool usage, leveraging a dedicated output parser for dialogue flow.

nodes.label: Conversational Output Parser
nodes.title: Parses output for conversational agents
nodes.description: Interprets the LLM's response to determine if it's a final answer or an action to be taken by a conversational agent.

nodes.label: Conversational Chat Agent
nodes.title: Agent for chat with tool integration
nodes.description: A specialized conversational agent that integrates tools and manages chat history using message placeholders.

nodes.label: Format to Tool Messages
nodes.title: Converts agent actions to tool messages
nodes.description: Transforms agent action and observation tuples into a list of BaseMessage objects, suitable for tool-calling models.

nodes.label: Create JSON Chat Agent
nodes.title: Factory for JSON-formatted chat agents
nodes.description: Constructs an agent that uses JSON for its internal logic and communication, designed specifically for chat models.

nodes.label: MRKL Chain
nodes.title: Implements the MRKL system for agents
nodes.description: An AgentExecutor that integrates the MRKL (Memory, Reasoning, Knowledge, Language) system using ZeroShotAgent and specific tools.

nodes.label: OpenAI Assistant Runnable
nodes.title: Runnable for OpenAI Assistants API interaction
nodes.description: Enables interaction with OpenAI Assistants, managing threads, runs, and tool calls, with optional integration into AgentExecutor.

nodes.label: Create OpenAI Functions Agent
nodes.title: Factory for OpenAI function-calling agents
nodes.description: Generates an agent that leverages OpenAI's native function calling capabilities by binding tools to the LLM and formatting messages.

nodes.label: OpenAI Multi-Functions Agent
nodes.title: Agent for multiple OpenAI tool calls
nodes.description: Handles scenarios where an LLM needs to make multiple tool calls in a single turn using OpenAI's function-powered API.

nodes.label: Create OpenAI Tools Agent
nodes.title: Factory for OpenAI tool-calling agents
nodes.description: Constructs an agent that utilizes OpenAI's tool calling feature, binding tools to the LLM and formatting intermediate steps.

nodes.label: ReAct JSON Output Parser
nodes.title: Parses ReAct-style JSON LLM output
nodes.description: Interprets LLM responses formatted in ReAct-style JSON, distinguishing between agent actions and final answers.

nodes.label: ReAct TextWorld Agent
nodes.title: Agent for ReAct TextWorld environments
nodes.description: A specialized agent for the ReAct TextWorld chain, enforcing the use of a single 'Play' tool.

nodes.label: ReAct Chain (Deprecated)
nodes.title: Deprecated ReAct paper implementation
nodes.description: An older implementation of the ReAct paper, using a DocstoreExplorer for search and lookup tools. Users are advised to migrate.

nodes.label: Self-Ask With Search Agent
nodes.title: Agent implementing self-ask with search strategy
nodes.description: Applies the self-ask with search reasoning strategy, expecting a single 'Intermediate Answer' tool for follow-up questions.

nodes.label: Create Self-Ask With Search Agent
nodes.title: Factory for self-ask with search agents
nodes.description: Constructs an agent that uses the self-ask with search prompting strategy, configuring it with a specific tool and stop sequences.

nodes.label: Self-Ask With Search Chain (Deprecated)
nodes.title: Deprecated self-ask with search chain
nodes.description: An older implementation of the self-ask with search chain, typically using a search API. Users are advised to migrate.

nodes.label: Structured Chat Agent
nodes.title: Agent for structured chat with multi-input tools
nodes.description: Designed for chat interactions that require structured outputs and support tools with multiple input parameters, using a retry-enabled output parser.

nodes.label: Create Structured Chat Agent
nodes.title: Factory for structured chat agents
nodes.description: Constructs an agent for structured chat, handling tools with multiple inputs, intermediate steps, and stop sequences.

nodes.label: Structured Chat Output Parser (Retries)
nodes.title: Output parser for structured chat with retry logic
nodes.description: Parses structured chat agent outputs, incorporating retry mechanisms and an optional output fixing parser for robustness.

nodes.label: Create Tool-Calling Agent
nodes.title: Factory for general tool-calling agents
nodes.description: A versatile factory function that creates agents capable of using various tools, binding them to the LLM and formatting messages for tool calls.

nodes.label: XML Agent
nodes.title: Agent using XML tags for reasoning
nodes.description: An agent that structures its reasoning and tool interactions using XML tags, constructing XML logs from intermediate steps.

nodes.label: Create XML Agent
nodes.title: Factory for XML-formatted agents
nodes.description: Constructs an agent that uses XML for its internal logic and communication, processing intermediate steps and binding stop sequences.

nodes.label: Create Agent (Modern)
nodes.title: Comprehensive factory for modern agent graphs
nodes.description: The recommended modern factory function for building advanced agent workflows using state graphs, supporting middleware, structured output, and various models.

nodes.label: Model Node (Modern Sync)
nodes.title: Synchronous model processing node in agent graph
nodes.description: Handles synchronous model requests within the modern agent graph, preparing inputs, executing the model, and processing its response.

nodes.label: Model Node (Modern Async)
nodes.title: Asynchronous model processing node in agent graph
nodes.description: Handles asynchronous model requests within the modern agent graph, preparing inputs, executing the model, and processing its response.

nodes.label: Model to Tools Router (Modern)
nodes.title: Routes agent graph based on model output
nodes.description: Determines the next step in the modern agent graph after the model's response, deciding whether to invoke tools, return a final answer, or loop back.

nodes.label: Structured Output Tool Binding
nodes.title: Manages metadata for structured output tools
nodes.description: Tracks schema, type classification, and tool implementation for structured responses generated via tool calls in modern agents.

nodes.label: Provider Strategy Binding
nodes.title: Manages native structured output metadata
nodes.description: Handles schema, type classification, and parsing logic for structured output directly from LLM providers in modern agents.

nodes.label: Deprecated Module Access
nodes.title: Handles access to deprecated agent modules
nodes.description: Provides backward compatibility and raises informative errors when attempting to access deprecated agent components or toolkits.

nodes.label: LLM Chain
nodes.title: Language Model Chain
nodes.description: A sequence that combines a language model with a prompt template to generate responses.

nodes.label: Agent Executor
nodes.title: Orchestrates agent execution
nodes.description: The runtime for agents, managing the loop of thought, action, and observation.

nodes.label: Base Tool
nodes.title: Abstract base for tools
nodes.description: Defines the interface for tools that agents can use to interact with the outside world.

nodes.label: Base Language Model
nodes.title: Abstract base for language models
nodes.description: Provides a common interface for all language models, enabling consistent interaction across different LLM providers.

nodes.label: Base Prompt Template
nodes.title: Abstract base for prompt templates
nodes.description: Defines the interface for creating and managing prompts for language models.

nodes.label: Agent Output Parser
nodes.title: Abstract base for agent output parsers
nodes.description: Defines how an agent's raw LLM output is parsed into structured actions or final answers.

nodes.label: Base Single Action Agent
nodes.title: Abstract base for single-action agents
nodes.description: Provides the foundational interface for agents that execute one action at a time.

nodes.label: Base Multi-Action Agent
nodes.title: Abstract base for multi-action agents
nodes.description: Provides the foundational interface for agents capable of executing multiple actions concurrently or in a single turn.

nodes.label: Runnable
nodes.title: Composable unit of execution
nodes.description: A generic interface for any component that can be invoked, streamed, or batched, enabling flexible composition of workflows.

nodes.label: Runnable Serializable
nodes.title: Serializable Runnable component
nodes.description: A Runnable that can be serialized and deserialized, allowing for persistence and sharing of components.

nodes.label: Runnable Passthrough
nodes.title: Passes input through unchanged
nodes.description: A Runnable that simply passes its input through to the next component, often used for injecting values or transforming inputs.

nodes.label: Chat Prompt Template
nodes.title: Template for chat prompts
nodes.description: A specialized prompt template for chat models, structuring messages into roles like system, human, and AI.

nodes.label: Messages Placeholder
nodes.title: Placeholder for message history
nodes.description: A component within a chat prompt template that dynamically inserts message history or agent scratchpad content.

nodes.label: System Message
nodes.title: System-level message
nodes.description: A message type representing instructions or context provided to the LLM from the system.

nodes.label: Human Message
nodes.title: User-generated message
nodes.description: A message type representing input or queries from a human user.

nodes.label: AI Message
nodes.title: AI-generated message
nodes.description: A message type representing output or responses generated by the AI.

nodes.label: Function Message
nodes.title: Tool function result message
nodes.description: A message type containing the result of a tool function call, used to inform the LLM.

nodes.label: Tool Message
nodes.title: Tool output message
nodes.description: A message type containing the output from a tool invocation, used to inform the LLM about tool execution results.

nodes.label: System Message Prompt Template
nodes.title: Template for system messages
nodes.description: A prompt template specifically for generating system messages.

nodes.label: Human Message Prompt Template
nodes.title: Template for human messages
nodes.description: A prompt template specifically for generating human messages.

nodes.label: Prompt Template
nodes.title: Generic prompt template
nodes.description: A general-purpose template for constructing prompts from input variables.

nodes.label: Output Parser Exception
nodes.title: Exception for parsing errors
nodes.description: An exception raised when an output parser fails to interpret the LLM's response.

nodes.label: Output Fixing Parser
nodes.title: Corrects malformed LLM outputs
nodes.description: A parser that attempts to fix errors in LLM-generated output, often by re-prompting or using another LLM.

nodes.label: Agent Token Buffer Memory
nodes.title: Memory for agent intermediate steps
nodes.description: Stores agent's intermediate steps within a token limit, allowing the agent to remember past actions and observations.

nodes.label: Conversation Token Buffer Memory
nodes.title: Memory for conversational history
nodes.description: Stores conversational chat history within a token limit, maintaining context for ongoing dialogues.

nodes.label: Base Memory
nodes.title: Abstract base for memory systems
nodes.description: Defines the interface for memory components that store and retrieve conversational history or agent state.

nodes.label: Base Callback Manager
nodes.title: Abstract base for callback managers
nodes.description: Manages callbacks for various events during the execution of LangChain components.

nodes.label: Callbacks
nodes.title: Callback handler interface
nodes.description: An interface for handling events during the execution of LangChain components, enabling logging, tracing, and custom actions.

nodes.label: Agent Middleware
nodes.title: Intercepts and modifies agent behavior
nodes.description: A component that can intercept and modify the behavior of an agent at various stages of its execution.

nodes.label: Checkpointer
nodes.title: Persists agent state
nodes.description: Saves and restores the state of an agent graph, enabling long-running conversations and fault tolerance.

nodes.label: Base Store
nodes.title: Abstract base for data storage
nodes.description: Defines the interface for persistent storage of data across multiple agent threads or sessions.

nodes.label: Base Cache
nodes.title: Abstract base for caching
nodes.description: Defines the interface for caching mechanisms to store and retrieve computation results, improving performance.

nodes.label: Base Chat Model
nodes.title: Abstract base for chat models
nodes.description: Provides a common interface for chat-optimized language models, handling message-based interactions.

nodes.label: VectorStore Toolkit
nodes.title: Toolkit for VectorStore operations
nodes.description: A collection of tools specifically designed for interacting with vector stores.

nodes.label: VectorStore Router Toolkit
nodes.title: Toolkit for routing across VectorStores
nodes.description: A collection of tools enabling an agent to route queries to different vector stores based on content.

groups.label: Agent Core Abstractions
groups.title: Foundational Agent Interfaces
groups.description: Contains the fundamental abstract classes and utility functions that define the basic structure and behavior of AI agents.

groups.label: Classic Agent Factories
groups.title: Functions for Creating Classic Agents
groups.description: Provides factory functions for instantiating agents using older or classic patterns, often based on LLMChains and specific prompting strategies.

groups.label: Classic Agent Implementations
groups.title: Specific Agent Strategies (Classic)
groups.description: Concrete implementations of various agent strategies, including conversational, ReAct, self-ask, and structured chat agents, often built upon the core Agent class.

groups.label: Output Parsing
groups.title: LLM Output Interpretation
groups.description: Components responsible for parsing the raw output from Language Models into structured agent actions or final answers, enabling the agent's decision-making process.

groups.label: Modern Agent Framework
groups.title: Advanced Agent Graph Orchestration
groups.description: The contemporary framework for building sophisticated agents using state graphs, supporting middleware, structured output, and flexible model integration for complex workflows.

groups.label: Deprecation Utilities
groups.title: Backward Compatibility & Migration Guidance
groups.description: Components that manage deprecated agent features, providing backward compatibility and guiding users towards newer, recommended implementations.
